readings.title: The Breach at Peor
readings.subtitle: The Zeal of Phinehas
readings.text: [Numbers 25:1] And Israel dwelt in Shittim, and the people began to whore with the daughters of Mo’aḇ. [2] And they invited the people to the slaughterings of their mighty ones, and the people ate and bowed down to their mighty ones. [3] Thus Israel was joined to Ba’al Pe’or, and the displeasure of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> burned against Israel. [4] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to Mosheh, <dq>“Take all the leaders of the people and hang them up before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> before the sun, so that the burning displeasure of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> turns away from Israel.”</dq> [5] And Mosheh said to the judges of Israel, “Each one of you kill his men who were joined to Ba’al Pe’or.” [6] And see, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Miḏyanite woman before the eyes of Mosheh and before the eyes of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Appointment. [7] And when Pineḥas, son of El’azar, son of Aharon the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation and took a spear in his hand, [8] and he went after the man of Israel into the tent and pierced both of them, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. And the plague was stopped from the children of Israel. [9] And those who died in the plague were twenty-four thousand. [10] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [11] <dq>“Pineḥas, son of El’azar, son of Aharon the priest, has turned back <dn>My</dn> wrath from the children of Israel, because he was ardent with <dn>My</dn> ardour in their midst, so that <dn>I</dn> did not consume the children of Israel in <dn>My</dn> ardour.</dq> [12] <dq>“Therefore say, ‘See, <dn>I</dn> am giving him <dn>My</dn> covenant of peace,</dq> [13] <dq>and it shall be to him and to his seed after him a covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was ardent for his <dn>Elohim</dn>, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”</dq> [14] And the name of the man of Israel who was killed, who was killed with the Miḏyanite woman, was Zimri, son of Salu, a leader of a father’s house among the Shim’onites. [15] And the name of the Miḏyanite woman who was killed was Kozbi, daughter of Tsur; he was head of the people of a father’s house in Miḏyan. [16] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [17] <dq>“Distress the Miḏyanites, and you shall smite them,</dq> [18] <dq>for they distressed you with their tricks with which they deceived you in the matter of Pe’or and in the matter of Kozbi, daughter of a leader of Miḏyan, their sister, who was killed in the day of the plague because of Pe’or.”</dq>

readings.title: The Second Census
readings.subtitle: The Families of Reuben, Simeon, and Gad
readings.text: [Numbers 26:1] And it came to be, after the plague, that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh and El’azar, son of Aharon the priest, saying, [2] <dq>“Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel from twenty years old and above, by their fathers’ houses, everyone going out to the army in Israel.”</dq> [3] And Mosheh and El’azar the priest spoke with them in the desert plains of Mo’aḇ by the Yardĕn of Yeriḥo, saying, [4] “From twenty years old and above,” as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded Mosheh and the children of Israel who came out of the land of Mitsrayim: [5] Re’uḇĕn, first-born of Israel. The children of Re’uḇĕn: of Ḥanoḵ, the family of the Ḥanoḵites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites; [6] of Ḥetsron, the family of the Ḥetsronites; of Karmi, the family of the Karmites. [7] These are the families of the Re’uḇĕnites, and their registered ones were forty-three thousand seven hundred and thirty. [8] And the son of Pallu: Eliyaḇ. [9] And the sons of Eliyaḇ: Nemu’ĕl, and Daṯan, and Aḇiram. These are the Daṯan and Aḇiram, called ones of the congregation, who contended against Mosheh and against Aharon in the company of Qoraḥ, when they contended against <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, [10] and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up with Qoraḥ, when that company died, when the fire consumed two hundred and fifty men. And they became a sign. [11] But the sons of Qoraḥ did not die. [12] The sons of Shim’on according to their families: of Nemu’ĕl, the family of the Nemu’ĕlites; of Yamin, the family of the Yaminites; of Yaḵin, the family of the Yaḵinites; [13] of Zeraḥ, the family of the Zarḥites; of Sha’ul, the family of the Sha’ulites. [14] These are the families of the Shim’onites: twenty-two thousand two hundred. [15] The sons of Gaḏ according to their families: of Tsephon, the family of the Tsephonites; of Ḥaggi, the family of the Ḥaggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites; [16] of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Ěri, the family of the Ěrites; [17] of Aroḏ, the family of the Aroḏites; of Ar’ĕli, the family of the Ar’ĕlites. [18] These are the families of the sons of Gaḏ according to their registered ones: forty thousand five hundred.

readings.title: The Census Continued
readings.subtitle: The Families of Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, and Joseph
readings.text: [Numbers 26:19] The sons of Yehuḏah: Ěr and Onan. And Ěr and Onan died in the land of Kena’an. [20] And the sons of Yehuḏah according to their families: of Shĕlah, the family of the Shĕlanites; of Perets, the family of the Partsites; of Zeraḥ, the family of the Zarḥites. [21] And the sons of Perets: of Ḥetsron, the family of the Ḥetsronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites. [22] These are the families of Yehuḏah according to their registered ones: seventy-six thousand five hundred. [23] Sons of Yissaḵar according to their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Puvites; [24] of Yashuḇ, the family of the Yashuḇites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites. [25] These are the families of Yissaḵar according to their registered ones: sixty-four thousand three hundred. [26] Sons of Zeḇulun according to their families: of Sereḏ, the family of the Sereḏites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Yaḥle’ĕl, the family of the Yaḥle’ĕlites. [27] These are the families of the Zeḇulunites according to their registered ones: sixty thousand five hundred. [28] Sons of Yoseph according to their families: Menashshĕh and Ephrayim. [29] Sons of Menashshĕh: of Maḵir, the family of the Maḵirites. And Maḵir brought forth Gil’aḏ; of Gil’aḏ, the family of the Gil’aḏites. [30] These are the sons of Gil’aḏ: of I’ezer, the family of the I’ezerites; of Ḥĕleḵ, the family of the Ḥĕleḵites; [31] of Asri’ĕl, the family of the Asri’ĕlites; of Sheḵem, the family of the Sheḵemites; [32] of Shemiḏa, the family of the Shemiḏaites; of Ḥĕpher, the family of the Ḥĕpherites. [33] And Tselophḥaḏ son of Ḥĕpher had no sons, but daughters. And the names of the daughters of Tselophḥaḏ: Maḥlah, and No’ah, Ḥog̱lah, Milkah, and Tirtsah. [34] These are the families of Menashshĕh, and their registered ones: fifty-two thousand seven hundred. [35] These are the sons of Ephrayim according to their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalḥites; of Beḵer, the family of the Baḵrites; of Taḥan, the family of the Taḥanites. [36] And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Ěran, the family of the Ěranites. [37] These are the families of the sons of Ephrayim according to their registered ones: thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Yoseph according to their families. [38] Sons of Binyamin according to their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashḇĕl, the family of the Ashḇĕlites; of Aḥiram, the family of the Aḥiramites; [39] of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Ḥupham, the family of the Ḥuphamites. [40] And the sons of Bela were Arḏ and Na’aman: of Arḏ, the family of the Arḏites; of Na’aman, the family of the Na’amanites. [41] These are the sons of Binyamin according to their families, and their registered ones: forty-five thousand six hundred.

readings.title: The Census Concluded
readings.subtitle: The Families of Dan, Asher, Naphtali, and the Sum of Israel
readings.text: [Numbers 26:42] These are the sons of Dan according to their families: of Shuaḥam, the family of the Shuaḥamites. These are the families of Dan according to their families. [43] All the families of the Shuaḥamites, according to their registered ones: sixty-four thousand four hundred. [44] Sons of Ashĕr according to their families: of Yimnah, the family of the Yimnites; of Yishwi, the family of the Yishwites; of Beri’ah, the family of the Beri’ites. [45] Of the sons of Beri’ah: of Ḥeḇer, the family of the Ḥeḇerites; of Malki’ĕl, the family of the Malki’ĕlites. [46] And the name of the daughter of Ashĕr was Saraḥ. [47] These are the families of the sons of Ashĕr according to their registered ones: fifty-three thousand four hundred. [48] Sons of Naphtali according to their families: of Yaḥtse’ĕl, the family of the Yaḥtse’ĕlites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites; [49] of Yĕtser, the family of the Yĕtserites; of Shillĕm, the family of the Shillĕmites. [50] These are the families of Naphtali according to their families, and their registered ones: forty-five thousand four hundred. [51] These are the registered ones of the children of Israel: six hundred and one thousand seven hundred and thirty.

readings.title: The Inheritance and the Levites
readings.subtitle: Division of the Land and the Families of Levi
readings.text: [Numbers 26:52] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [53] <dq>“The land is to be divided to these as an inheritance, according to the number of names.</dq> [54] <dq>“To the large one you increase his inheritance, and to the small one you decrease his inheritance. Each is to be given his inheritance according to their registered ones.</dq> [55] <dq>“But the land is divided by lot. They inherit according to the names of the tribes of their fathers.</dq> [56] <dq>“According to the lot their inheritance is divided between the large and the small.”</dq> [57] And these are the registered ones of the Lĕwites according to their families: of Gĕreshon, the family of the Gĕreshonites; of Qehaṯ, the family of the Qehaṯites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites. [58] These are the families of the Lĕwites: the family of the Liḇnites, the family of the Ḥeḇronites, the family of the Maḥlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Qorḥites. And Qehaṯ brought forth Amram. [59] And the name of Amram’s wife was Yoḵeḇeḏ the daughter of Lĕwi, who was born to Lĕwi in Mitsrayim. And to Amram she bore Aharon and Mosheh and their sister Miryam. [60] And to Aharon were born Naḏaḇ and Aḇihu, El’azar and Ithamar. [61] And Naḏaḇ and Aḇihu died when they brought strange fire before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [62] And their registered ones were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and above. For they were not registered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given to them among the children of Israel. [63] These are the ones registered by Mosheh and El’azar the priest, who registered the children of Israel in the desert plains of Mo’aḇ by the Yardĕn of Yeriḥo. [64] But among these there was not a man of those registered by Mosheh and Aharon the priest when they registered the children of Israel in the Wilderness of Sinai. [65] For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had said of them, <dq>“They shall certainly die in the wilderness.”</dq> And not a man was left of them, except Kalĕḇ son of Yephunneh, and Yehoshua son of Nun.
